contea di ritrovamento: City of Peterborough (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy nummus of the House of Theodosius, AD 378-402 (Reece period 21). Reverse legend reads [SALVS REI PVBLICAE]. Reverse shows Victory advancing left, holding trophy and dragging captive. Mint is uncertain, AD 388-402. Obverse legend is illegible. Obverse shows a diademed, draped and cuirassed bust right. Reverse fields and exergue read: / //[...]. Die axis is 6 o'clock. Weight is…
